MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Route.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Route.

RouteID.description: Unique identifier of this Route instance.

OfflineMapID.description: Identifier of the Offline Map to which this Route refers.

RouteSegments.description: Ordered sequence of route segments, each defined by two Way Points.

WayPoint1ID.description: Identifier of the starting Way Point of this segment on the Offline Map.

WayPoint2ID.description: Identifier of the ending Way Point of this segment on the Offline Map.

EstimatedArrDepSpaceTime.description: Estimated arrival and departure Space/Time at WayPoint2ID.

ActualArrDepSpaceTime.description: Actual arrival and departure Space/Time at WayPoint2ID.

SegmentState.description: Road State at this segment at the time of traversal.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Route in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Route (plain text, max 2048 characters).
